name: Capture One
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Capture One, catalog and adjust local raw files with a deliberately limited editing pipeline. The hard boundary is proprietary raw rendering, tethering, color tools, camera profiles, and studio workflow, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
